label: PROCEED WITH CONDITIONS
call: The council would start with a small position in NVIDIA, and add more only if its data center sales keep growing faster than 40% a year for the next two quarters [F006].

why.point: The price already assumes about 24% growth a year for five years [F018]. Possible, but it leaves no room for error on a full position.
It is an exceptional business, earning more than 70% on the money it reinvests [F012].
A small position limits the damage if the AI spending boom cools.

minority.quote: People are paying for a spending boom as if it will last forever.
minority.would_have_to_be_true: For starting small to go wrong, big tech would have to cut its AI spending in 2027.

fights.crux: Is AI chip demand here to stay, or a boom that will cool?
fights.story: Druckenmiller and Damodaran said it lasts; Burry, Marks and Munger said it cools. Nobody moved on demand, so the council settled on size instead.

premortem: Big tech companies pause AI spending and orders dry up for two quarters.
Rivals' own chips win business and NVIDIA's margins fall below 70%.
New export rules hit, or one of the four biggest customers cuts orders.

kill_criteria.text: Profit on each sale (gross margin) stays under 70% for two quarters
The four biggest customers become a bigger share of sales

conditions: Data center sales growth stays above 40% a year [F006]

next_steps.action: Decide the starter size by the loss you could live with.
Write down the reasons you would sell.
Read the results against the conditions.

cheapest_test: Wait two days for the results before adding anything beyond the starter.
price_implies: The price implies about 24% growth a year for five years [F018], inside a value range of $150 to $205 [F019] [F021].
sizing_note: The record holds a 66% fall [F029]. Size the starter so that a fall like that would not change how you live.

behavioral_flags.quote: everyone is buying it and I do not want to miss out

lean_pull_note: Buying all now gained 0.3 after the lean was shared; not enough to change the call.
data_health: Prices from Yahoo, filings from the SEC, rates from the Treasury and the New York Fed; no analyst estimates or news.

amendments.amendment: Add more only after two quarters of proof.
amendments.reason: Matches the condition the council set.

amendments.amendment: Keep the starter small enough that a fall to $150 would not shake you.

seat_lines.buffett: Buy the business, not the excitement.
seat_lines.munger: Know your exit before you enter.
seat_lines.damodaran: Value is a range. Pay inside it.
seat_lines.marks: The best time to be careful is when everyone else is not.
seat_lines.taleb: Survive first. Size so the worst case is a lesson.
seat_lines.druckenmiller: Own it while money is easy, and watch the central bank.
seat_lines.burry: Know who the four customers are and what they plan to spend.
